steps.content:
Buy from **Seller A - Brackmoor Sound**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/hn22ms/a

Not from Seller B - Ottervale Audio:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/hn22ms/b

On the surface they look identical:

* Same product: Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* Same price: **$129.00**
* Same shipping: In stock, free standard shipping, 3 to 5 business days
* Same returns: 30-day returns
* Same rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* Both pages even *claim*: "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

The difference is when you check the manufacturer’s list they both link to:

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/hn22ms/dealers

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: **Brackmoor Sound, Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.**

* **Ottervale Audio is NOT on that list.** Despite what its listing claims, it is not an authorized dealer, so you would not get the full manufacturer warranty.

Since price, shipping and returns are the same, buy the one where the warranty claim is true: **Seller A, Brackmoor Sound.**
